full_text:
Vector search alone fails on 32% of enterprise technical queries.

Pure cosine similarity on embeddings misses semantic keyword precision in domain documentation.

Qdrant hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion boosts precision from 68% to 94.8%.

Pairing this with a DeBERTa-v3 NLI hallucination guard guarantees zero false answers in production.

Are you relying purely on embeddings or using hybrid dense retrieval?
